items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: The transcript only contains the interviewer mentioning 'HE FIRED HIS COUSIN' referring to Snub Mosley. The interviewee does not speak or confirm any personal relationship with this cousin.

ctx.x: One of the greatest who ever picked up a stick.
He fired his cousin and put A.G. in there. And nobody blamed him. I don't think his cousin blamed. His cousin was spellbound by A.G.-------
